facts.fact: Lands Minister of State Harriet Ntabazi said the ministry's survey, mapping and registration departments have been equipped with upgraded digital systems, a blockchain-based land records system has been developed, and satellite and drones will be used to capture parcels.
Minister Ntabazi said that with the new digitalisation system applicants enter their data in the computer at district level and have their title printed.
